notes:
Default off is untouched: omniscient is a new field defaulting to false; every determinize_with call site in decide.rs (run_worlds world 0 and worlds>=1 threads, window_choice, commit_play_dialog, commit_setup_box) now goes through sample_world(), which calls determinize_with exactly as before when omniscient=false (same rng consumption). Goldens (audit 3,386 + replay 200) pass unchanged.
TreeMcts::run in mcts.rs still calls determinize_with directly; it is not on the decide path (decide uses run_in_world), so it was left alone.
omniscient=true: the world is a clone of the real state and NO shuffle is drawn from the rng (so the later Dirichlet/temperature draws shift vs. off; irrelevant since this is a separate measurement mode). Own deck order was already the real order in the current determinization (only the opponent's hand+deck is re-drawn), so 'both decks visible' follows from not re-drawing.
worlds>1 with omniscient is treated as 1 via DecideOptions::effective_worlds (rethink, which only raises worlds, therefore becomes a same-seed re-read of the same world).
The spec named arena.py '_CAND_KEYS'; that name does not exist on the mainline -- the equivalent tables are CAND_FLAGS (boolean flags) / CAND_VALUE_FLAGS, so --cand-omniscient is a CAND_FLAGS entry. Ledger rows carry cand_opts.omniscient=true.
Visibility is search-only; play after the chosen move is unchanged (game-illegal by design, flagged as measurement-only in docstrings/help). Serve API default unchanged (RsGame.decide passes the key only when omniscient=True).
Test (c) uses a counting rng on the main (tree) path plus a direct sample_world check; no dedicated battle/dialog-window test (window_choice and the commits go through the same sample_world helper).
Local arena +79.5 Elo [CI 0.499..0.726] on 40 pairs -- between the +20..+50 and +100 reading bands of n_loop_ops §7.24 and too wide to decide; the production arena (12 x 120 pairs) is the judge.
